proxyDialogDescription: Choose how EasySSH connects to the network.
proxySystemDescription: Follow Windows proxy settings, including automatic configuration.
proxySystemEnvironmentDescription: Use the HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY environment variables.
proxyDirectDescription: Connect to the network without a proxy.
proxyManualDescription: Use a specific HTTP, HTTPS or SOCKS5 proxy.
proxyAddressHint: Enter a full address and port (1–65535), such as http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Enter credentials in the fields below.
proxyUsernamePlaceholder: Leave blank if no authentication is needed
proxyPasswordSavedPlaceholder: Saved; leave blank to keep it
proxyAuthenticationHint: Supports HTTP / HTTPS Basic authentication and SOCKS5 username/password authentication. Passwords are encrypted. Re-enter the password after changing the proxy address or username.
proxyCredentialsInvalidMessage: HTTP / HTTPS usernames cannot contain a colon. SOCKS5 usernames and passwords must each contain 1–255 bytes.
proxyScopeDescription: Applies to AI, updates and data sync. SSH / SFTP are unaffected. Loopback addresses always connect directly. Saved changes apply to new requests; ongoing requests keep their current connection.
proxyLoadFailedMessage: Could not load proxy settings. Close this dialog and try again.
proxySaveFailedMessage: Could not save proxy settings. Check the proxy configuration, system credential store and data directory permissions, then try again.
updateDialogDescription: Check whether a new EasySSH Desktop version is available.
updateAvailableDescription: A new version is ready to download and install.
updateLatestDescription: This EasySSH Desktop installation is on the latest version.
updateCheckFailedDescription: Unable to fetch the latest version right now.
updateRestartFailedTitle: Failed to restart and apply the update. Please try again.
updateReadyDescription: Restart to switch to the new version.
updateInlineRetryTitle: Click to download the update again
updateFailureRelaunchedDescription: The previous version is still available or has been relaunched. Review the failure reason or copy the manual replacement command.
updateFailureNotRelaunchedDescription: The update failed and the previous version could not be relaunched automatically. Review the failure reason and replace manually if needed.
updateFailureManualDescription: Close EasySSH, then run the PowerShell command below to copy the new file into place and restart.
updateFailureManualUnavailable: The new file path is missing, so a manual replacement command cannot be generated. Download the release zip, extract it, and replace EasySSH.exe manually.
